summary: End-to-end testing of SightEco AI: backend pytest (6 tests, 5 passed, 1 minor failure on history field shape) and Playwright frontend coverage of upload→caption flow, TTS controls, A11y panel, language toggle, history panel, keyboard shortcut. Real Gemini 2.5 Pro vision captions generated successfully for both English and Hindi. Upload flow works end-to-end. One TTS-related issue likely tied to headless Chromium and one cosmetic backend response shape issue identified.

minor.issue: Response items still include the field `image_preview: null` even though MongoDB projection excludes it. Cause: `response_model=List[CaptionEntry]` re-adds the optional field. Spec asked for the field to be excluded from history response. Fix: either set `response_model_exclude={'image_preview'}` on the route, switch the response model to a slimmer model (without image_preview), or call `model_dump(exclude={'image_preview'})` on each item.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='play-caption-button'] does not change UI state to show [data-testid='pause-caption-button'] in headless browser. window.speechSynthesis.speaking and .pending both remain false after click. This may be a known headless Chromium limitation (no voices loaded -> getVoices() returns []), but the UI should still flip to a 'speaking' state optimistically and rely on onend/onerror to revert. Recommend updating useSpeech to set isPlaying=true synchronously on speak() invocation rather than waiting for the unreliable onstart event, and to fall back gracefully if voices array is empty.

verified_flows: POST /api/predict (image/jpeg, language=hi) -> 200, caption contains Devanagari characters
GET /api/history -> 200, list, _id excluded (image_preview field still present as null - minor)
DELETE /api/history -> 200, returns deleted count, subsequent GET returns []
Frontend loads with Hero title 'Seeing the world through AI' and yellow CTA (testid hero-upload-cta)
Upload via [data-testid=upload-file-input] triggers POST /api/predict, shows [data-testid=upload-loading] spinner, then displays real caption in [data-testid=caption-text]

[data-testid=open-a11y-panel-button] opens panel; high-contrast-toggle, dark-mode-panel-toggle, voice-guidance-toggle, lang-en-button, lang-hi-button, font-decrease-button, font-reset-button, font-increase-button all present
high-contrast-toggle adds 'high-contrast' class on document.documentElement (verified true)
lang-hi-button switches UI text to Hindi ('साइटईको AI' rendered)
[data-testid=history-section] displays past captions; history populated with 2 items after uploads
action_items: Fix /api/history response to exclude image_preview field entirely (use response_model_exclude or a leaner response model).

Improve useSpeech hook in /app/frontend/src/a11y.jsx to update isPlaying state immediately on speak() so the Pause button surfaces, and to handle environments where speechSynthesis.getVoices() is empty (headless / first-load) by waiting on the 'voiceschanged' event before bailing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: predict endpoint stores up to ~300KB base64 image_preview in MongoDB which can bloat the captions collection over time; consider storing thumbnails on disk or limiting all images to a small thumbnail (e.g., 64x64) before storage.
server.py: response_model on /history vs MongoDB projection mismatch - projection-side exclusion is overridden by response_model adding optional fields back; pick one source of truth.
server.py: temp file is created on every request and deleted in finally - good, but consider sending bytes directly via FileContentWithMimeType if supported to avoid disk I/O.
Frontend useSpeech: relying solely on browser speech events for UI state is fragile; debounce-update isPlaying on click for snappier UX.

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6 pytest passed; predict EN, predict HI, reject text, root status, clear history all PASS; history shape minor fail)
success_rate.frontend: 92% (upload flow, captions EN/HI, A11y panel, contrast toggle, language toggle, history all working; only TTS button-state flip not verifiable in headless)

test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created 2 caption entries via uploads during testing; cleared via DELETE /api/history at the end of pytest run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_sighteco_api.py is the regression suite. Real-content JPEGs are generated programmatically with PIL inside the test. Gemini calls take ~10-15s each. Frontend hero CTA testid is 'hero-upload-cta' (not 'hero-cta-button'). Font controls use suffix '-button' (font-increase-button, font-decrease-button, font-reset-button). Caption-text element is always present so to detect a real caption, poll until placeholder text ('appear here' / 'यहाँ') is gone.
